notes.title: Soundtrack DLC
notes.content:
The soundtrack for The Search is now live! 5 mp3 tracks from the game are now free to download.

Track Listing:
1. The Threshold (0:39) - Jason Godbey
2. Ouendake (3:32) - Goldmund (Keith Kenniff)
3. Unseen Forces At Work (2:55) - Jewelbeat
4. Web Of Deceit (2:06) - Jewelbeat
5. The Search (2:09) - Jewelbeat

They will show up as a zip file in your Steam directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\The Search

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28409456/9e559631d16ecff19a4cf80f0b3624306aea8c9b.png[/img]
